input: tag two cross-sections from four consistent rails and sweep them
expected: four rails with consistent start/direction/span tag both profiles with om9.four-rail-profile metadata, and Sweep4 consumes them as one four-boundary surface
notes: OM9-TOOLS-032 is an alias of the existing OM9-TOOLS-004 metadata command; both record the same stable command and label, so a recipe is not split by the icon used.
Five or more selected curves on OM9-TOOLS-004 take the four-rail path; a smaller selection is treated as a custom rail.
